items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I had the old musicians with me. ... Gassoun ... I had all old musicians.

ctx.x: Soon after you started? That's right. Who else was in there in a band?

I had the old musicians with me. Really? That's right, I had old man granny, Alphonse Pico, Johnny Dave, Lil' Orange Toker, Gassoun, you remember Gassoun, you got to. I had all old musicians. Lil' Orange Toker and me was the two youngest fellas. I mostly worked with old fellas, I mean when I started, I mean, most old fellas.
And Toker was the carnet player?
